title: Reservation Pickup Location Cleanup
lede: The reservation flow now answers one operational question clearly: where will this gear be picked up? Only the two active counters remain selectable while event venues stay intact as schedule context.

stats.n: Field House is removed from the reservation selector; Camp Randall and Kohl Center remain
Selecting a Field House event no longer overwrites the pickup counter
Allowlist, create/edit/draft routes, event defaults, and reservation UI contracts

sections.heading: Matched selector capture
sections.note: Fixture capture at the same viewport and scroll position; the only intended visual difference is the removed Field House option.

pairs.title: Reservation Step 1 pickup menu
pairs.sub: The menu is open so the available pickup counters are directly comparable; 92,878 of 490,000 pixels changed (18.95%), beginning at the removed row and expected downstream reflow.
pairs.beforeCap: Source-control baseline: Camp Randall Stadium, Kohl Center, and UW Field House were offered.
pairs.afterCap: Current behavior: only Camp Randall Stadium and Kohl Center are offered.

changes.h: The reservation menu exposed an unsupported counter
changes.was: The shared location catalog flowed directly into the web reservation picker, so UW Field House could be selected as a pickup location.
changes.now: A reservation-scoped allowlist keeps Camp Randall and Kohl Center in the picker and bulk reservation control. Server checks reject unsupported or inactive reservation locations across create, edit, candidate, and draft paths.

changes.h: Event selection could silently choose the pickup counter
changes.was: Selecting an event copied its mapped venue into the reservation location, even when that venue was not an operational pickup counter.
changes.now: Event selection still derives title and timing, but pickup remains an explicit counter choice. Existing event venues and historical Field House records are preserved.

verification: Focused tests: 70 passing across pickup allowlist, reservation create/edit/draft routes, event defaults, and booking UI contracts.
Web gates: npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false, npm run lint, and npm run build:app pass.

Review capture: matched before/after fixture screenshots were captured at 700x700; 92,878 of 490,000 pixels changed (18.95%), with the difference bounded to the removed option row and expected content reflow below it.
notes: The global location catalog was not deleted or filtered: Field House remains available for event venue mapping, inventory context, and historical records.
No database rows were changed, no migration was needed, and no deployment or authenticated production acceptance was performed.
